title_en: Close to the Prosecutor's Office of Tirana, 2+1+2 apartment for sale, with a perfect location!!
description_en: Close to the Prosecutor's Office of Tirana, on Prokop Myzeqari street, 2+1+2 apartment for sale, with a perfect location!!! The apartment is located on the first floor of an existing building. The apartment has a net area of ​​98 m2. The organization of the apartment begins with the corridor that divides the living room together with the dining and cooking area, two bedrooms, two balconies and two bathrooms with windows. Orientation from East and West that makes it light during most of the day. The area offers many facilities, starting from the perfect location, the proximity to the Center and the institutions, and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment, since the rents are very high in that area. The apartment has the possibility of being divided into two apartments. It has full mortgage documentation.
